accrued_orders_wizard.perpetual_purchase_override: stock_variation_account overrides expense account for perpetual storable products

stock_gr_ir.continental_default: No GR/IR interim clearing; anglo_saxon_accounting=False by default
stock_gr_ir.anglo_saxon_mode: price_difference_account used only when company.anglo_saxon_accounting=True AND cost_method=standard
stock_gr_ir.location_valuation_account: StockLocation.valuation_account_id provides location-based interim account mechanism
stock_gr_ir.cogs_on_customer_invoice: stock_valuation credited, expense debited at invoice posting time (perpetual)

period_close.period_control: Lock dates on res.company: fiscalyear_lock_date, tax_lock_date, sale_lock_date, purchase_lock_date, hard_lock_date
period_close.secure_entries_wizard: account.secure.entries.wizard provides cryptographic hashing of journal chains

stock_valuation_closing.periods: daily and last-day-of-month for monthly companies

claims.statement: The accrued-orders wizard class is `AccountAccruedOrdersWizard` (transient model `account.accrued.orders.wizard`). The file is `accrued_orders.py`, not `account_accrued_orders_wizard.py`.
Field `reversal_date` is declared on the wizard; its default compute sets it to `date + 1 day`. This enables automatic reversal creation at post time.
`_compute_reversal_date` sets `reversal_date = date + relativedelta(days=1)` whenever the existing reversal_date is not posterior to the accrual date. Enforces reversal date must be after entry date.

For purchase orders the accrual account domain is `account_type = 'liability_current'`; for sale orders it is `account_type = 'asset_current'`. The counterpart account is user-selected but domain-restricted by order type.

For purchase lines the per-line account is the product `expense` account (from `get_product_accounts`). For sale lines it is the product `income` account. Fiscal position is applied via `fiscal_pos` parameter.

For purchase lines with storable products under perpetual valuation, `stock_variation_account` overrides the expense account as the line-level debit/credit account, capturing the GR/IR accrual on the variation account rather than P&L.

The single counterpart line (debit or credit of `self.account_id`) is created only when `total_balance != 0` (company-currency precision). It carries the sum of all line balances negated, ensuring the accrual entry is balanced.

`create_entries` (the wizard action button) creates the accrual entry, posts it immediately via `_post()`, then creates and posts the reversal via `_reverse_moves()` with the user-supplied `reversal_date`. Both moves are posted in the same call.

`_reverse_moves` is called with `default_values_list` containing `ref='Reversal of: %s'` and `date=self.reversal_date`. The reversal is immediately posted (`reverse_move._post()`), making the two-move accrual/reversal pair fully automated.
A `UserError` is raised when `reversal_date <= date`, preventing invalid accrual/reversal date ordering before any entry is created.

For purchase lines: `price_unit` is `price_unit_discounted`. When `quantity_to_invoice >= 1`, the price unit is recalculated from posted invoice lines and received values to correct for partial billing.

The base implementation of `_get_product_expense_and_stock_var_accounts` returns `(False, False)`. Stock-specific override (in `stock_account`) is expected to return expense and stock-variation accounts for perpetual-valuation products.

`fiscalyear_lock_date` (Global Lock Date) is a `fields.Date` on `res.company` (inherited by `account`). Any entry with `date <= fiscalyear_lock_date` is blocked or postponed to a later date per journal sequence.
`hard_lock_date` (Hard Lock Date) is irreversible and cannot be unlocked by exceptions. Entries dated on or before this date cannot be added or modified under any circumstance.
`sale_lock_date` and `purchase_lock_date` are separate per-journal-type soft lock dates on `res.company`, restricting sales and purchase journals independently.

`_check_fiscal_lock_dates` is called on write and post operations. It calls `_get_lock_date_violations` checking all applicable lock dates for the move's journal type and raises `UserError` with formatted lock date info when any lock is violated.
The method passes `fiscalyear=True, sale=(journal.type=='sale'), purchase=(journal.type=='purchase'), tax=False, hard=True` — lock checking is scoped per journal type at enforcement time.

`action_close_stock_valuation` on `res.company` is the month-end stock close entry point. It calls `_action_close_stock_valuation`, creates an `account.move` with ref `'Stock Closing'` using `account_stock_journal_id`, and posts it when `auto_post=True`.

`_action_close_stock_valuation` builds journal item value lists by calling three methods: `_get_location_valuation_vals` (location reclassification), `_get_stock_valuation_account_vals` (stock vs accounting delta), and `_get_continental_realtime_variation_vals` (continental perpetual variation).

`_cron_post_stock_valuation` is the scheduled action method. It runs daily and adds `'monthly'` period on the last day of the month. It searches companies with `inventory_period in ['daily', 'monthly']` and calls `action_close_stock_valuation(auto_post=True)` per company.

The `ir.cron` record `ir_cron_post_stock_valuation` is defined as `interval_number=1`, `interval_type=days`, active, model `res.company`, executing `model._cron_post_stock_valuation()`. This is the only stock-valuation-related scheduled action.

`_get_last_closing_date` reads the last up-to-10 closing `account.move` IDs from `ir.config_parameter` key `{company_id}.stock_valuation_closing_ids`. It finds the most recent posted closing move and returns its date, enabling range-based delta computation between closings.
A `UserError` is raised when `at_date` is earlier than the last closing date, preventing insertion of closing entries that would break the temporal order of stock closing sequence.

`_stock_account_prepare_realtime_out_lines_vals` generates COGS journal items (display_type='cogs') for customer invoices of perpetual-valuation products. It uses `accounts['stock_valuation']` as the credit account and `accounts['expense']` as the debit account for the COGS pair.

`AccountMove._post` is overridden in `stock_account`: it calls `_stock_account_prepare_realtime_out_lines_vals` before `super()._post()` to inject COGS lines at invoice posting time. This is the perpetual valuation trigger for outgoing goods.

`_stock_account_prepare_anglo_saxon_in_lines_vals` creates price-difference journal items (display_type='cogs') for vendor bills only when `company.anglo_saxon_accounting=True` AND product `cost_method='standard'`. These lines debit a price-difference account and credit the invoice line account.

The anglo-Saxon price-difference lines are skipped entirely when `company.anglo_saxon_accounting` is False (the Community default). This means no GR/IR interim clearing account is generated in the standard continental setup.

`StockLocation.valuation_account_id` is an optional `account.account` field on stock locations. When set, movements into/from that location generate reclassification entries at stock closing (periodic) or immediately (real-time via `_get_account_move_line_vals`).

`_get_account_move_line_vals` uses `location_id.valuation_account_id` as the credit account (with `stock_valuation` as debit) when source location has a valuation account; otherwise uses `location_dest_id.valuation_account_id` as debit (with `stock_valuation` as credit). This is the location-based interim account mechanism.

`AccountSecureEntriesWizard` (transient model `account.secure.entries.wizard`) provides period-close hashing. It finds all unhashed posted entries before `hash_date` and calls `_hash_moves(force_hash=True)` to cryptographically secure journal chains. This is the Community period-close mechanism beyond lock dates.

The cron `ir_cron_auto_post_draft_entry` runs daily at 02:00, posting all draft entries with `auto_post` enabled and accounting date up to today. This is the only account-module cron. There is no period-close or accrual-specific cron in the `account` module.

`SOFT_LOCK_DATE_FIELDS` constant lists four soft lock date fields: `fiscalyear_lock_date`, `tax_lock_date`, `sale_lock_date`, `purchase_lock_date`. There is no `account.period` model in Odoo 19 Community; period control is entirely via lock dates on `res.company`.

`_get_continental_realtime_variation_vals` computes the stock variation over a fiscal year period for continental perpetual valuation. It compares current accounting value vs accounting value at fiscal year start (`compute_fiscalyear_dates`) and posts the net variation between `variation_acc` and `expense_acc`.

`inventory_period` on `res.company` has selections `'manual'`, `'daily'`, `'monthly'`. The cron only processes companies with `inventory_period in ['daily', 'monthly']`; companies set to `'manual'` require explicit user action to close stock valuation.
